# Security Policy

## Scope

This policy covers the Gripad site, its build tooling, and any protocol code published from this repository.

## Reporting a problem

Please do not open a public issue for a vulnerability. A private reporting channel will be published here together with the official links; until then, do not disclose details in public places. When the channel exists, include what you found, how to reproduce it, and what you think the impact is.

## What we do

- Acknowledge a report promptly.
- Keep you informed while we investigate.
- Credit you in the fix notes if you wish.

## Ground rules for the project

- No private keys, seed phrases or tokens in the repository, ever.
- The site loads no third-party scripts. Outbound requests are limited to the origins named in the content security policy.
- The console and any hook tooling must never ask a user for a seed phrase.

## Impersonation

Until a contract address and official links appear on the site, treat any token or account claiming to be Gripad as unofficial.
